name: release-rebalance-saveslots-0.2.0
desc: Rebalance SaveSlots 0.2.0: open on the slot you last saved/loaded, Q/E page by 5 rows, key hint under the list.
commits: feat(rebalance-saveslots): focus the last used slot, Q/E page by 5, key hint (0.2.0)

ShowHook always selected row 0; the screen now opens on the slot used in this run (ReadStorage/SaveStorage postfixes remember Model.SelectedStorageIndex), else StorageHistoryManager.GetLatestStorageIndex. Q/E (gamepad L1/R1) move the selection 5 rows through the Core input gate without swallowing input, and a hint line with the game's key icons is drawn under the list. Requires Restitutor.Core 0.2.0+.
chore: release script for Rebalance SaveSlots 0.2.0
